cohort: Pregnancies with SUA (n=127) compared to pregnancies with a normal 3-vessel umbilical cord (n=27,752)
finding: Singleton pregnancies with SUA were associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery, NRFHR, lower birth weight, and lower umbilical cord blood pH.
mod_finding: Pregnancies with a single umbilical artery resulted in a higher rate of cesarean delivery due to non-reassuring fetal heart rate compared to pregnancies with a normal three-vessel umbilical cord.
